about_page.title: Import and distribution of medical devices and consumables for modern healthcare
about_page.story_p1: Medilink is a company dedicated to the import and distribution of medical devices and consumables for healthcare institutions, private practices, and other healthcare professionals in North Macedonia.
about_page.story_p2: Our goal is to build a reliable and professional partnership with healthcare providers, delivering access to high-quality medical products and consistent supply for their daily operations.
about_page.partner_p1: As part of our offer, we collaborate with Troge Medical, a German manufacturer and partner in the field of medical devices and consumables. Through this partnership, Medilink provides access to a wide range of products tailored for various medical sectors.
about_page.partner_p2: Our product portfolio covers protective equipment, surgery, urology, transfusion, infusion therapy, syringes and needles, diagnostics, and other essential medical supplies.
about_page.philosophy_p1: As a growing business, we believe trust is built right from the first interaction. That is why we focus on delivering professional service, prompt communication, and safe, timely deliveries tailored to every partner's requirements.
about_page.philosophy_p2: Our vision is to progressively expand a reliable network across North Macedonia and become a recognized, trusted supplier of medical supplies.

partners_page.title: Global brands. Registered supply.
partners_page.subtitle: Medilink is a licensed importer and distributor of medical consumables, officially registered with the Agency for Medicines and Medical Devices of North Macedonia (MALMED).
partners_page.brand_bio: With over 35 years of global healthcare experience, the German brand Troge Medical is synonymous with top German quality and rigorous medical standards.
partners_page.portfolio_title: Officially registered range in North Macedonia:

exam_gloves.title: Examination gloves
exam_gloves.desc: High-quality non-sterile protective gloves for diagnostic and general healthcare procedures.

surg_gloves.title: Surgical gloves
surg_gloves.desc: Sterile anatomical gloves offering optimal protection and tactile sensitivity for operating rooms.

sutures.title: Surgical sutures
sutures.desc: Advanced absorbable and non-absorbable wound closure solutions for surgical procedures.

transfusion.title: Transfusion
transfusion.desc: Specialized safe system sets and bags for blood transfusion and blood derivatives.

urology.title: Urology
urology.desc: Foley balloon catheters, urine collection bags, and auxiliary consumables for urological care.

syringes.title: Syringes and needles
syringes.desc: Sterile medical syringes and hypodermic needles crafted for maximum sharpness and reliability.

infusion.title: Infusion therapy
infusion.desc: IV cannulas, infusion sets, flow regulators, and dedicated therapy accessories.

diagnostic.title: Diagnostic devices
diagnostic.desc: Precision medical equipment and instruments for primary diagnostics in healthcare environments.

surgery.title: Surgery and anesthesia
surgery.desc: Specialized consumables intended for clinical anesthesia and surgical operations.
